LIST OF THE COUNCIL OF MINISTER SWORN - IN
AT 10.45 A.M. ON MONDAY, 14 JANUARY, 1980,
IN THE RASHTRAPATI BHAVAN.

blocks.html:
1.Shrimati Indira Gandhi...Prime Minister/All Ministries/ Departments not specified below.
2.Rao Birendra Singh...Minister of Agriculture.
3.Shri B. Shankaranand...Minister of Education.

7.Shri V.P. Sathe...Minister of Information and Broadcasting.
8.Giani Zail Singh...Minister of Home Affairs

11.Shri A.P. Sharma...Minister of Shipping and Transport
12.Shri J.B. Patnaik...Minister of Tourism and Civil Aviation.
13.Shri P.C. Sethi...Minister of Works and Housing
14.Shri Bhishma Narain Singh...Minister of Parliamentary Affairs.
15.Shri Pranab Mukherjee...Minister of Commerce.
